examples.en: During the summer drought, smooth pebbles were exposed along the dry streambed.
examples.zh: 在夏季的干旱期间，干涸的河床上裸露出一颗颗光滑的卵石。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 streambed 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 超级油轮, 巨大油轮
lemmas.def_en: the largest class of oil tankers

examples.en: The massive supertanker carried millions of barrels of crude oil across the ocean.
examples.zh: 那艘巨大的超级油轮载着数百万桶原油横渡了大洋。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 supertanker 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: climbing garden plant having fragrant pastel-colored flowers

examples.en: She planted fragrant sweetpea along the garden fence to attract colorful fluttering butterflies.
examples.zh: 她在花园篱笆旁种了芬芳的香豌豆，以吸引五彩斑斓的蝴蝶。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sweetpea 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: kettle for boiling water to make tea

examples.en: The copper teakettle whistled loudly on the stove when the water boiled.
examples.zh: 水烧开时，炉子上的铜茶壶发出了响亮的汽笛声。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 teakettle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 五极管, 电子五极管
lemmas.def_en: a thermionic tube having five electrodes

examples.en: The technician carefully replaced the faulty pentode in the vintage guitar audio amplifier.
examples.zh: 技术人员小心地更换了这台老式吉他音频放大器中损坏的五极管。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pentode 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [药]去炎松,氟羟氢化泼尼松,氟羟泼尼松龙,氟羟强的松龙
lemmas.def_en: a synthetic corticosteroid (trade names Aristocort or Aristopak or Kenalog) used as an anti-inflammatory agent

examples.en: The dermatologist prescribed a mild triamcinolone cream to treat the severe skin rash.
examples.zh: 皮肤科医生开了一种温和的去炎松软膏来治疗严重的皮疹。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 triamcinolone 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [医] 拔毛发癖, 拔毛发狂
lemmas.def_en: an irresistible urge to pull out your own hair

examples.en: She sought professional therapy to manage her trichotillomania during times of intense stress.
examples.zh: 她在压力极大的时期寻求了专业心理治疗，以控制自己的拔毛发癖。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 trichotillomania 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: undergarment worn next to the skin and under the outer garments

examples.en: He packed several pairs of warm underclothes before embarking on the winter expedition.
examples.zh: 在踏上冬季探险之旅前，他打包了几套保暖的内衣。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 underclothes 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an edition containing various versions of a text or notes by various scholars or editors

examples.en: The literature professor consulted a variorum edition to compare different readings of Hamlet.
examples.zh: 这位文学教授查阅了一部集注版，以比对《哈姆雷特》的不同异文。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 variorum 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 血管舒缩的, 影响血管舒缩的
lemmas.def_en: relating to the nerves and muscles that cause the blood vessels to constrict or dilate

examples.en: Stress can trigger sudden vasomotor responses that cause intense facial flushing.
examples.zh: 压力可能会引发突然的血管舒缩反应，导致面部严重发红。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 vasomotor 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (philosophy) a doctrine that life is a vital principle distinct from physics and chemistry

examples.en: Nineteenth-century biologists often debated the merits of vitalism versus pure mechanism.
examples.zh: 十九世纪的生物学家经常争论生机论与纯机械论的优劣。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 vitalism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a troubler who interrupts or interferes with peace and quiet; someone who causes disorder and commotion

examples.en: Security guards quickly escorted the loud disturber out of the auditorium.
examples.zh: 保安迅速将那个吵闹的捣乱者护送出了礼堂。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 disturber 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 浪费者, 饭桶, 浪子, 废品, 流浪者
lemmas.def_en: someone who dissipates resources self-indulgently

examples.en: He squandered his entire family inheritance like an irresponsible young wastrel.
examples.zh: 他像个不负责任的年轻浪子一样挥霍光了全部家产。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 wastrel 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: platform scale flush with a roadway for weighing vehicles and cattle etc

examples.en: The loaded truck paused on the heavy weighbridge to check its cargo weight.
examples.zh: 满载的卡车停在地秤上以检查货物重量。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 weighbridge 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 打, 抽出, 打败, 征服
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] (informal) To hit or strike something with a sharp, heavy slapping blow.

examples.en: She used a rolled newspaper to whap the aggressive wasp on the desk.
examples.zh: 她用卷起的报纸拍打了桌上那只极具攻击性的黄蜂。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 whap 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: minnows or other small fresh- or saltwater fish (especially herring); usually cooked whole

examples.en: The seaside restaurant serves delicious deep-fried whitebait with fresh lemon wedges.
examples.zh: 这家海边餐厅供应美味的炸小白鱼配鲜柠檬角。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 whitebait 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a cruel and brutal fellow

examples.en: A drunk yobo shouted insults at quiet pedestrians near the train station.
examples.zh: 一个醉酒的无业青年在火车站附近冲着安静的行人破口大骂。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 yobo 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to the fibula or the outer part of the leg below the knee

examples.en: The doctor examined the peroneal nerve after the patient reported lower leg numbness.
examples.zh: 在病人报告小腿麻木后，医生检查了其腓神经。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 peroneal 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [医] 机能不良, 功能紊乱, 官能障碍
lemmas.def_en: (medicine) any disturbance in the functioning of an organ or body part or a disturbance in the functioning of a social group

examples.en: Thyroid disfunction can cause extreme fatigue, rapid weight gain, and severe mood swings.
examples.zh: 甲状腺功能紊乱会导致极度疲劳、体重骤增和严重的情绪波动。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 disfunction 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a slight or partial paralysis

examples.en: The stroke victim suffered from mild paresis in his left arm and hand.
examples.zh: 这位中风患者的左臂和左手出现了轻微的不完全麻痹。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 paresis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a tumor consisting of fatty tissue

examples.en: The doctor confirmed that the small bump under her skin was just a benign lipoma.
examples.zh: 医生确认她皮下的那个小肿块只是一颗良性脂肪瘤。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lipoma 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 欺骗, 哄骗, 欺瞒
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] (+ out of) (North American informal) To obtain or arrange something through clever, devious, or dishonest methods.

examples.en: He managed to finagle two backstage passes to the sold-out rock concert.
examples.zh: 他想方设法弄到了两张那场售罄摇滚音乐会的后台通行证。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 finagle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the deck between the bridge and the forecastle

examples.en: The sailors gathered on the foredeck to secure the ship's heavy anchor chains.
examples.zh: 水手们聚集在前甲板上以固定船上的沉重锚链。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 foredeck 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the time period between dawn and noon

examples.en: We spent a productive forenoon reviewing financial reports and planning next month's budget.
examples.zh: 我们整个上午都在高效地审阅财务报告并规划下个月的预算。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 forenoon 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: capable of being broken

examples.en: Handle that antique porcelain bowl carefully because it is extremely old and frangible.
examples.zh: 小心轻放那个古董瓷碗，因为它年代久远且极其易碎。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 frangible 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: pastry with a creamy almond-flavored filling

examples.en: The baker topped the warm fruit tart with a sweet layer of almond frangipane.
examples.zh: 烘焙师在热水果挞上抹了一层甜甜的杏仁赤素馨风味酱。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 frangipane 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of various finches of Europe or America having a massive and powerful bill

examples.en: A colorful grosbeak landed on the snowy tree branch to eat dried berries.
examples.zh: 一只色彩艳丽的松雀落在积雪的树枝上吃干浆果。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 grosbeak 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a person afflicted with paranoia

examples.en: The conspiratorial paranoiac believed that government drones were constantly watching his house.
examples.zh: 那个偏执狂患者相信政府的无人机在不断监视他的房子。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 paranoiac 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 六步格, 六步格的诗
lemmas.def_en: a verse line having six metrical feet

examples.en: Homer composed the ancient epic poems in traditional dactylic hexameter verse.
examples.zh: 荷马用传统的长短短六步格诗体创作了这些古老史诗。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hexameter 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: something immaterial that interferes with or delays action or progress

examples.en: Lack of funding proved to be a serious hinderance to our research project.
examples.zh: 资金匮乏被证明是我们研究项目的一个严重障碍。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hinderance 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 批评苛刻的, 吹毛求疵的
lemmas.def_en: inclined to judge too severely

examples.en: Working under such a hypercritical manager made the junior employees extremely anxious.
examples.zh: 在这样一个吹毛求疵的经理手下工作让年轻员工们感到极其焦虑。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hypercritical 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 血钾过少, 低钾血症, 低钾血
lemmas.def_en: abnormally low level of potassium in the circulating blood leading to weakness and heart abnormalities; associated with adrenal tumors or starvation or taking diuretics

examples.en: Severe hypokalemia can cause dangerous muscle weakness and irregular heart rhythms.
examples.zh: 严重的低钾血症会导致危险的肌肉无力和心律失常。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hypokalemia 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 钻进, 把...印入, 深植
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (+ in/into) (linguistics / formal) To insert an affix inside the middle of a word, or implant an idea deeply.

examples.en: The teacher tried to infix strong moral principles into the young students' minds.
examples.zh: 老师试图将坚定的道德原则深植于年轻学生们的心中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 infix 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 忍耐不住的, 不合理的
lemmas.def_en: incapable of being justified or explained

examples.en: The sweltering heat in the crowded subway car quickly became insupportable.
examples.zh: 拥挤的地铁车厢内闷热难耐，很快令人无法忍受。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 insupportable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: very hard unsalted biscuit or bread; a former ship's staple

examples.en: Sailors often relied on dried hardtack for sustenance during long ocean voyages.
examples.zh: 在漫长的远洋航行中，水手们常靠吃硬饼干维生。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hardtack 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a natural body passageway

examples.en: The doctor examined the patient's external auditory meatus for any sign of infection.
examples.zh: 医生检查了患者的外耳道，看是否有感染迹象。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 meatus 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 海狸鼠, 海狸鼠毛皮
lemmas.def_en: aquatic South American rodent resembling a small beaver; bred for its fur

examples.en: Feral nutria have damaged the local wetlands by overfeeding on native vegetation.
examples.zh: 野生海狸鼠因过度啃食本土植被而破坏了当地的湿地。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 nutria 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: derived from a single fertilized egg

examples.en: Researchers study monozygotic twins to understand the subtle influences of nature versus nurture.
examples.zh: 研究人员通过研究同卵双胞胎来了解先天与后天因素的微妙影响。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 monozygotic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: aromatic perennial of southeastern Russia

examples.en: She added a pinch of chopped estragon to elevate the flavor of the sauce.
examples.zh: 她加入一小撮切碎的龙蒿，以提升酱汁的风味。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 estragon 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 骑马侍从, 先驱者,摩托车警卫
lemmas.def_en: an escort who rides ahead (as a member of the vanguard)

examples.en: A police outrider cleared the busy highway ahead of the presidential motorcade.
examples.zh: 一名摩托警卫在总统车队前清理繁忙的高速公路。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 outrider 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the branch of anatomy that studies the bones of the vertebrate skeleton

examples.en: The anthropology student took an advanced course in osteology to study ancient skeletons.
examples.zh: 这位人类学学生选修了一门高级骨学课程来研究古代骨骼。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 osteology 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the belief that the United States Constitution should be interpreted in the way the authors originally intended it

examples.en: The conservative judge based his ruling on a strict interpretation of originalism.
examples.zh: 这位保守派法官依据对原意主义的严格解释作出了裁决。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 originalism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 古代礼拜堂的前廊, 教堂前厅
lemmas.def_en: portico at the west end of an early Christian basilica or church

examples.en: Wedding guests gathered in the church narthex before entering the main sanctuary.
examples.zh: 婚礼宾客在进入主礼拜堂前先在教堂前厅集合。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 narthex 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: one thousandth (10^-3) of a second

examples.en: The high-speed camera recorded the explosion with an exposure time of one msec.
examples.zh: 这台高速相机以一毫秒的曝光时间记录了爆炸过程。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 msec 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 客观化, 外表性, 外表化, 客观性
lemmas.def_en: attributing to outside causes

examples.en: Journaling allows for the safe externalization of painful thoughts and anxieties.
examples.zh: 写日记有助于将痛苦的想法和焦虑安全地外化出来。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 externalization 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 翘着不易压平的一绺头发
lemmas.def_en: a tuft of hair that grows in a different direction from the rest of the hair and usually will not lie flat

examples.en: He tried smoothing down the stubborn cowlick with water, but it bounced right back.
examples.zh: 他试图用水把那绺翘起的头发压平，但它马上又翘了起来。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cowlick 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 阿莫拉（犹太教律法学者，犹太教口传律法集《塔木德》的编集者）
lemmas.def_en: one of a group of rabbis (active AD 250-500) who discussed the Mishnaic law in the law schools of Palestine and Mesopotamia where they explained and applied earlier teachings and whose discussions are recorded in the Talmud; they emphasized the study of Torah and the importance of personal action and the fulfillment of the commandments

examples.en: The legal opinions of the ancient amora were faithfully recorded in the Talmud.
examples.zh: 这位古代阿莫拉学者的法律观点被如实记录在《塔木德》中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 amora 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a high speed centrifuge used to determine the relative molecular masses of large molecules in high polymers and proteins

examples.en: The lab technician used an ultracentrifuge to isolate delicate viral particles from the sample.
examples.zh: 实验技术人员使用超离心机从样品中分离出脆弱的病毒颗粒。

lemmas.def_en: centrifugation at very high speeds

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ultracentrifuge 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a candy made by spinning sugar that has been boiled to a high temperature

examples.en: Children clutched huge cones of pink candyfloss while watching the carnival rides.
examples.zh: 孩子们一边看着嘉年华游乐设施，一边抓着巨大的粉色棉花糖。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 candyfloss 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: bedding rolled up for carrying

examples.en: The weary hiker unstrapped his bedroll and laid it out beside the campfire.
examples.zh: 疲惫的徒步旅行者解下铺盖卷，把它铺在篝火旁。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bedroll 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [解](人的)跟骨,(哺乳动物的) 空凹足
lemmas.def_en: the largest tarsal bone; forms the human heel

examples.en: He suffered a hairline fracture in his calcaneus after jumping from the high wall.
examples.zh: 从高墙上跳下后，他的跟骨发生了隐裂。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 calcaneus 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an inlaid furniture decoration; tortoiseshell and yellow and white metal form scrolls in cabinetwork

examples.en: The antique cabinet was adorned with exquisite boulle work made of brass and tortoiseshell.
examples.zh: 这个古董柜装饰着由黄铜和玳瑁制成的精致镶嵌细工。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 boulle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: very drunk

examples.en: After downing several pints of dark beer, he was completely blotto and could barely walk.
examples.zh: 灌下几品脱黑啤酒后，他烂醉如泥，几乎无法行走。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 blotto 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the framework of a bed

examples.en: She polished the antique brass bedstead until it gleamed brightly in the soft afternoon light.
examples.zh: 她把那张老式黄铜床架擦得锃亮，在午后柔和的光线下闪闪发光。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bedstead 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 社论式广告( 指常作为杂志中心插页的正式广告文字)
lemmas.def_en: an advertisement that is written and presented in the style of an editorial or journalistic report

examples.en: The magazine published a glossy advertorial that cleverly disguised a commercial product as a health report.
examples.zh: 该杂志刊登了一篇精美的软文广告，巧妙地将商业产品伪装成健康报告。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 advertorial 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a structure or device in which one end is counterbalanced by the other (on the principle of the seesaw)

examples.en: Traffic halted completely as the heavy bascule rose smoothly to let the tall cargo ship pass.
examples.zh: 沉重的活动桁架平稳升起让高大的货船通过，交通完全停顿了。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bascule 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a broad cartridge belt worn over the shoulder by soldiers

examples.en: The revolutionary slung a heavy leather bandolier packed with brass cartridges across his dusty chest.
examples.zh: 那名革命者将装满黄铜子弹的沉重皮质子弹带斜挎在布满灰尘的胸前。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bandolier 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 谐音, 准押韵, 半押韵
lemmas.def_en: the repetition of similar vowels in the stressed syllables of successive words

examples.en: The poet used subtle assonance, repeating similar vowel sounds to create a quiet, haunting mood.
examples.zh: 诗人运用微妙的半押韵，重复相似的元音来营造安静、萦绕心头的情调。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 assonance 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to associations or associationism

examples.en: Our brains rely heavily on complex associational networks to quickly retrieve old memories and emotions.
examples.zh: 我们的大脑高度依赖复杂的联想网络来快速调取旧时的记忆和情感。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 associational 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: pressed close to or lying flat against something; ; -L.V.Pirsson

examples.en: The botanist carefully noted the appressed leaves that grew tightly flattened against the slender stem.
examples.zh: 植物学家仔细记录了那些紧紧贴服在细茎上生长的叶片。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 appressed 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 正横(与船的龙骨成直角)
lemmas.def_en: at right angles to the length of a ship or airplane

examples.en: The lookout spotted another fishing vessel cruising slowly abeam of our starboard side at twilight.
examples.zh: 黄昏时分，瞭望员发现另一艘渔船正沿着我们右舷的正横方向缓缓航行。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 abeam 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: one of the three sections of the hipbone; situated below the ilium

examples.en: The radiologist pointed to a hairline fracture in the patient's ischium on the clear X-ray.
examples.zh: 放射科医生在清晰的X光片上指出了患者坐骨处的一道细微裂纹。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ischium 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: not basic or fundamental

examples.en: To finish on schedule, we cut all inessential tasks and focused solely on core requirements.
examples.zh: 为了按时完工，我们削减了所有无关紧要的任务，只专注于核心需求。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 inessential 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the dead body of an animal especially one slaughtered and dressed for food

examples.en: Vultures circled patiently in the cloudless sky above the abandoned carcase of an old truck.
examples.zh: 秃鹰在万里无云的天空中耐心地盘旋，下方是一辆废弃卡车的残骸。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 carcase 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an epicycloid in which the rolling circle equals the fixed circle

examples.en: In advanced mathematics class, students learned how to trace a cardioid curve using polar equations.
examples.zh: 在高等数学课上，学生们学习了如何使用极坐标方程绘制心形线。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cardioid 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (music) the fourth note of the diatonic scale

examples.en: The pianist lingered on the subdominant chord before finally resolving smoothly to the tonic note.
examples.zh: 钢琴家在次属音和弦上稍作停留，然后平稳地过渡到主音。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 subdominant 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a reduced ability to focus on near objects caused by loss of elasticity of the crystalline lens after age 45

examples.en: As he entered his late forties, presbyopia forced him to start wearing reading glasses regularly.
examples.zh: 刚过四十五岁，老花眼就迫使他开始经常佩戴老花镜。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 presbyopia 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a flattering commendation (especially when used for promotional purposes)

examples.en: The clever consumer dismissed the extravagant claims on the shampoo bottle as mere advertising puffery.
examples.zh: 精明的消费者把洗发水瓶上夸大其词的说辞斥为纯粹的广告吹捧。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 puffery 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: something (usually a supporting document) that is enclosed in an envelope with a covering letter

examples.en: The legal dispute centered around the unlawful inclosure of common village land by the wealthy landlord.
examples.zh: 这起法律纠纷的焦点在于富裕的地主非法圈占村庄共有土地。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 inclosure 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: widespread European weed having yellow daisylike flowers; sometimes an obnoxious weed and toxic to cattle if consumed in quantity

examples.en: Farmers worked tirelessly to pull poisonous ragwort from the pasture before the hungry cattle grazed there.
examples.zh: 农民们不知疲倦地从牧场拔除有毒的千里光草，以免饥饿的牛群误食。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ragwort 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: reconnaissance (by shortening)

examples.en: The soldiers went ahead to do a quick recco of the enemy camp before dawn.
examples.zh: 天亮前，士兵们先行出发，对敌方营地进行了快速侦察。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 recco 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: flycatching warbler of eastern North America the male having bright orange on sides and wings and tail

examples.en: A handsome redstart perched on the garden fence, flicking its bright tail in the morning sunlight.
examples.zh: 一只漂亮的红尾鸲栖在花园围栏上，在晨光中抖动着鲜艳的尾羽。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 redstart 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of a group of picornaviruses that are responsible for many upper respiratory infections

examples.en: Doctors confirmed that the common cold outbreak across the primary school was caused by a rhinovirus.
examples.zh: 医生证实，这所小学爆发的普通感冒是由鼻病毒引起的。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rhinovirus 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不许可地, 不允许地
lemmas.def_en: not permissibly

examples.en: The construction company built impermissibly close to the protected wetland, triggering hefty government fines immediately.
examples.zh: 该建筑公司的施工违规逼近受保护的湿地，立即招致了巨额政府罚款。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 impermissibly 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a bag for carrying school books and supplies

examples.en: He packed his heavy textbooks and a metal pencil case neatly into his new schoolbag.
examples.zh: 他把沉重的课本和一个金属铅笔盒整齐地装进了新书包里。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 schoolbag 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: unchanged in value following multiplication by itself

examples.en: In web development, the HTTP GET method is designed to be completely idempotent and safe.
examples.zh: 在网页开发中，HTTP GET 方法被设计为完全幂等且安全的操作。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 idempotent 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: in a shrill voice

examples.en: The old alarm clock rang shrilly across the quiet bedroom, startling him awake at dawn.
examples.zh: 老旧的闹钟在安静的卧室里尖叫起来，在破晓时分将他惊醒。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 shrilly 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a movie without a soundtrack

examples.en: Many actors struggled to transition from the silents to the talkies.
examples.zh: 许多演员难以从无声电影转型到有声电影。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 silents 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the branch of forestry dealing with the development and care of forests

examples.en: Modern silviculture practices help balance timber production with forest conservation.
examples.zh: 现代造林实践有助于平衡木材生产与森林保护。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 silviculture 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to Sisyphus

examples.en: Cleaning the house with three toddlers feels like a Sisyphean task.
examples.zh: 带着三个刚学步的孩子打扫屋子简直是一项西西弗斯式的苦差事。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sisyphean 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the spouse of your parent by a subsequent marriage

examples.en: She formed a close and loving bond with her new stepparent.
examples.zh: 她与新继父母建立了亲密而深厚的情感联系。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 stepparent 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 石工, 石匠, 琢石机
lemmas.def_en: someone who cuts or carves stone

examples.en: The skilled stonecutter carved intricate patterns into the marble block.
examples.zh: 技术精湛的石匠在整块大理石上雕刻出复杂的图案。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 stonecutter 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 轮箍, 条纹, 狭长草地
lemmas.def_en: thick plank forming a ridge along the side of a wooden ship

examples.en: Workers carefully inspected the wooden strake along the ship's lower hull.
examples.zh: 工人们仔细检查了沿着船体下部的木质列板。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 strake 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 红细胞增多症, 红血球增多症
lemmas.def_en: a disorder characterized by an abnormal increase in the number of red blood cells in the blood

examples.en: His chronic dizziness was eventually linked to a mild form of polycythemia.
examples.zh: 他长期的头晕最终被证实与一种轻度红细胞增多症有关。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 polycythemia 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a liturgical chant of the Roman Catholic Church

examples.en: The choir's haunting plainsong echoed beautifully through the medieval cathedral.
examples.zh: 唱诗班空灵的素歌在中世纪大教堂内美妙地回荡。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 plainsong 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 金色铜制的, 冒牌的, 廉价的
lemmas.def_en: serving as an imitation or substitute

examples.en: He bought a pinchbeck watch that lost its luster within weeks.
examples.zh: 他买了一只廉价仿金手表，几周内就失去了光泽。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pinchbeck 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an unstable meson produced as the result of a high-energy particle collision

examples.en: Physicists observed the rare decay of a neutral kaon in the accelerator.
examples.zh: 物理学家在加速器中观察到了中性K介子的罕见衰变。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 kaon 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [植] (生长于沼泽的)瑞香科小树或灌木
lemmas.def_en: shrub or small tree of southeastern United States to West Indies and Brazil; grown for the slender racemes of white flowers and orange and crimson foliage

examples.en: We found flexible branches of leatherwood growing near the swampy creek.
examples.zh: 我们在沼泽小溪旁发现了生长着的枝条柔软的瑞香木。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 leatherwood 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the driver and keeper of an elephant

examples.en: The experienced mahout guided the gentle elephant through the dense jungle.
examples.zh: 经验丰富的象夫引导着温顺的大象穿过茂密的丛林。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mahout 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 鼹鼠皮, 斜纹棉布, 斜纹棉布裤
lemmas.def_en: a durable cotton fabric with a velvety nap

examples.en: He wore durable trousers made of moleskin during the winter hike.
examples.zh: 他在冬日徒步时穿着一条用厚斜纹棉布制成的耐磨裤子。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 moleskin 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (economics) a market in which goods or services are offered by several sellers but there is only one buyer

examples.en: The small town faced a monopsony, with only one major employer hiring.
examples.zh: 这个小镇面临着买方垄断，只有一家大型雇主在招人。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 monopsony 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a fine strong sheer silky fabric made of silk or rayon or nylon

examples.en: Her elegant evening dress featured soft layers of sheer ninon fabric.
examples.zh: 她那件优雅的晚礼服有着多层柔软轻薄的尼龙绸面料。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ninon 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 智力的, 纯理智的, 纯粹理性的
lemmas.def_en: of or associated with or requiring the use of the mind

examples.en: Meditation provided him with a profound noetic experience beyond ordinary reasoning.
examples.zh: 冥想带给他一种超越日常理性的深刻纯知性体验。

lemmas.def_en: the psychological result of perception and learning and reasoning

examples.en: In classical philosophy, noesis refers to direct intellectual perception of fundamental truths.
examples.zh: 在古典哲学中，纯粹理性是指对基本真理的直接理智感知。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 noetic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: measuring instrument for measuring the luminous intensity of a source by comparing it (visually or photoelectrically) with a standard source

examples.en: The technician used a sensitive photometer to measure the laboratory lighting.
examples.zh: 技术人员使用灵敏的光度计测量了实验室的光照强度。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 photometer 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不可避免的, 无法逃避的
lemmas.def_en: impossible to avoid or evade:

examples.en: Aging is an ineluctable reality that every living creature must face.
examples.zh: 衰老是每个活着的生灵都必须面对的不可避免的现实。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ineluctable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: abnormal skin sensations (as tingling or tickling or itching or burning) usually associated with peripheral nerve damage

examples.en: A pinched nerve in her neck caused persistent paresthesia in her fingers.
examples.zh: 她颈部受压的神经引起了手指持续的感觉异常。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 paresthesia 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a person who murders their father

examples.en: The tragic play tells the story of an ambitious prince committing patricide.
examples.zh: 这部悲剧讲述了一位野心勃勃的王子犯下杀父罪行的故事。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 patricide 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: growth of hair or wool or fur covering the body of an animal

examples.en: The arctic fox develops a thick white pelage for the winter months.
examples.zh: 北极狐在冬季会换上厚厚的白色毛皮。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pelage 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 薄皮, 薄膜, 分光薄膜
lemmas.def_en: thin protective membrane in some protozoa

examples.en: A thin pellicle formed over the cooling liquid in the beaker.
examples.zh: 烧杯中冷却的液体表面形成了一层薄薄的薄膜。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pellicle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a dense fibrous membrane covering the surface of bones (except at their extremities) and serving as an attachment for tendons and muscles; contains nerves and blood vessels that nourish the enclosed bone

examples.en: The surgeon carefully separated the periosteum from the bone before repairing the fracture.
examples.zh: 外科医生在修复骨折前，小心地将骨膜从骨头上剥离。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 periosteum 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: fish thought to have been extinct since the Cretaceous period but found in 1938 off the coast of Africa

examples.en: Scientists were astonished when a living coelacanth was discovered, defying extinction theories.
examples.zh: 当一条活着的腔棘鱼被发现时，科学家们大为震惊，这打破了灭绝理论。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 coelacanth 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: abnormally enlarged thyroid gland; can result from underproduction or overproduction of hormone or from a deficiency of iodine in the diet

examples.en: The physician noted a visible struma on her neck caused by iodine deficiency.
examples.zh: 医生注意到她颈部有一个因缺碘引起的明显甲状腺肿。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 struma 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [生理][心]联觉,牵连感觉, 共同感觉
lemmas.def_en: a sensation that normally occurs in one sense modality occurs when another modality is stimulated

examples.en: His synaesthesia allowed him to experience bright colors whenever he listened to music.
examples.zh: 他的联觉使他每当听到音乐时都能感受到鲜艳的色彩。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 synaesthesia 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a frame made of two hoops; used for embroidering

examples.en: She stretched the delicate silk fabric tightly across the wooden tambour before embroidering.
examples.zh: 刺绣前，她将精致的丝绸面料紧紧绷在木制绣圈上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tambour 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: = go to the dogs at dog n.
lemmas.def_en: a container that is usually woven and has handles

examples.en: He warned that the company was going to hell in a handbasket very quickly.
examples.zh: 他警告说，公司正极其迅速地滑向彻底崩溃的边缘。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 handbasket 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: （西非, 尤指旧时的）部族史（或传统）说唱艺人
lemmas.def_en: a storyteller in West Africa; perpetuates the oral traditions of a family or village

examples.en: The village gathered around the griot as he sang ancient legends of their ancestors.
examples.zh: 村民们聚在说唱艺人身旁，听他吟唱关于祖先的古老传说。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 griot 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any liliaceous plant of the genus Fritillaria having nodding variously colored flowers

examples.en: A colorful fritillary fluttered gently over the blooming wildflowers in the quiet meadow.
examples.zh: 一只色彩斑斓的豹纹蝶在安静草地上盛开的野花间轻轻飞舞。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fritillary 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: inflammation of a hair follicle

examples.en: Shaving with a dull razor caused mild folliculitis across his neck and chin.
examples.zh: 用钝剃须刀刮胡子导致他的颈部和下巴出现了轻度毛囊炎。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 folliculitis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a small loosely aggregated mass of flocculent material suspended in or precipitated from a liquid

examples.en: Chemicals were added to the wastewater to form floc that settled quickly.
examples.zh: 废水中加入了化学药剂，以形成能快速沉淀的絮状物。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 floc 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a slow or gradual disappearance

examples.en: The movie ended with a slow fadeout as the lone rider disappeared into dusk.
examples.zh: 随着孤独的骑手消失在黄昏中，电影在慢慢的渐隐中落幕。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fadeout 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: with little or no preparation or forethought

examples.en: Without any preparation, she delivered an extempore speech that captivated the entire audience.
examples.zh: 在毫无准备的情况下，她发表了一场即席演讲，吸引了全场观众。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 extempore 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a concise reference book providing specific information about a subject or location

examples.en: He kept an enchiridion of botanical terms in his pocket during fieldwork.
examples.zh: 在野外考察期间，他随身携带一本植物学名词便览。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 enchiridion 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: painful menstruation

examples.en: She took warm herbal tea and resting to relieve severe dysmenorrhea symptoms.
examples.zh: 她喝温热的草药茶并卧床休息，以缓解严重的痛经症状。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dysmenorrhea 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a mound of glacial drift

examples.en: The gentle slopes of the drumlin were formed thousands of years ago by glaciers.
examples.zh: 这座鼓丘平缓的斜坡是由冰川在数千年前塑造而成的。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 drumlin 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: pleochroism of a crystal so that it exhibits two different colors when viewed from two different directions

examples.en: The mineral displayed fascinating dichroism, changing color when viewed from different angles.
examples.zh: 这种矿物展现出迷人的两向色性，从不同角度观察会变换颜色。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dichroism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: (黑人穿的)颜色花哨的短袖套衫
lemmas.def_en: a loose and brightly colored African shirt

examples.en: He wore a brightly colored dashiki to celebrate his heritage at the cultural festival.
examples.zh: 他在文化节上穿了一件色彩鲜艳的短袖套衫来庆祝自己的传统。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dashiki 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the enclosed land around a house or other building

examples.en: The historic mansion and its surrounding curtilage are protected under local preservation laws.
examples.zh: 这座历史悠久的宅邸及其周边的庭院土地受到当地保护法的保护。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 curtilage 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the attendant (usually an officer of a nobleman's household) whose duty is to fill and serve cups of wine

examples.en: In ancient courts, the trusted cupbearer tasted all wine before serving the king.
examples.zh: 在古代宫廷中，深受信赖的斟酒官在为国王上酒前要先尝酒。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cupbearer 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a hired hand who tends cattle and performs other duties on horseback

examples.en: The experienced cowman herded the cattle across the rugged plains before sunset.
examples.zh: 经验丰富的放牛人在日落前将牛群赶过了崎岖的原野。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cowman 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 来得不巧的事情, 不幸的意外事, 切分音法
lemmas.def_en: an awkward clash

examples.en: A minor travel contretemps caused them to miss their connecting flight to Paris.
examples.zh: 旅途中一次小小的意外变故导致他们错过了飞往巴黎的联程航班。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 contretemps 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an informal conversation

examples.en: After a brief confabulation in the hallway, the managers agreed on a new plan.
examples.zh: 在走廊里简短交谈后，经理们就一项新计划达成了一致。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 confabulation 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 朝向天空的, 朝向天国的
lemmas.def_en: directed toward heaven or the sky

examples.en: She cast a heavenward glance, silently praying for patience and inner peace.
examples.zh: 她抬头望向天空，默默祈祷获得耐心与内心的平静。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 heavenward 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 助手, 伴侣, 终身伴侣
lemmas.def_en: a helpful partner

examples.en: Throughout his long and challenging career, his wife remained his devoted helpmate.
examples.zh: 在他漫长且充满挑战的职业生涯中，他的妻子始终是他忠诚的伴侣。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 helpmate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of several plants of the genus Hepatica having three-lobed leaves and white or pinkish flowers in early spring; of moist and mossy subalpine woodland areas of north temperate regions

examples.en: Small blue hepatica blossoms appeared on the forest floor, signaling the early spring.
examples.zh: 森林地面上绽放出蓝色的小朵獐耳细辛，预示着早春的到来。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hepatica 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 像醋的, 酸的, 尖酸的
lemmas.def_en: tasting or smelling like vinegar

examples.en: She rejected his rude apology with a vinegary look and walked away quickly.
examples.zh: 她带着尖酸的神情拒绝了他粗鲁的道歉，快步走开了。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 vinegary 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 龟甲形大盾, 掩蔽物
lemmas.def_en: a movable protective covering that provided protection from above; used by Roman troops when approaching the walls of a besieged fortification

examples.en: Roman legionaries formed a protective testudo to advance safely toward the enemy walls.
examples.zh: 罗马军团士兵结成龟甲盾阵，安全地向敌方城墙推进。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 testudo 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a surveying instrument for measuring horizontal and vertical angles, consisting of a small telescope mounted on a tripod

examples.en: The surveyor carefully leveled the theodolite before measuring the steep hillside angles.
examples.zh: 测量员在测量陡峭山坡的角度前，仔细调平了经纬仪。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 theodolite 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a booth at a tollgate where the toll collector collects tolls

examples.en: The captured thief was dragged through the town square to the local tolbooth.
examples.zh: 被抓获的小偷被拖过城镇广场，押往当地的牢狱。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tolbooth 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a gate or bar across a toll bridge or toll road which is lifted when the toll is paid

examples.en: Drivers must stop at the tollgate to pay the highway maintenance fee.
examples.zh: 司机必须在收费处停车，缴纳高速公路维护费。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tollgate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 能横过的, 能越过的, 可否认的
lemmas.def_en: capable of being traversed

examples.en: Heavy winter snow rendered the mountain pass barely traversable even for trucks.
examples.zh: 冬天的暴雪让这个山口即便对卡车来说也几乎无法通行。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 traversable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [法] 未修缮的, 破损的
lemmas.def_en: unserviceable because necessary repairs have not been made

examples.en: The unrepaired wooden bridge finally collapsed under the weight of the heavy truck.
examples.zh: 那座年久失修的木桥最终在重型卡车的重压下坍塌了。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 unrepaired 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [医]阴道痉挛(指由于阴道局部过敏而有痛感的痉挛)
lemmas.def_en: muscular contraction that causes the vagina to close; usually an anxiety reaction before coitus or pelvic examination

examples.en: Physical therapy and counseling can provide effective relief for women suffering from vaginismus.
examples.zh: 物理治疗和心理咨询能为患有阴道痉挛的女性提供有效缓解。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 vaginismus 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 小孩吃饭时用的高脚椅子
lemmas.def_en: a chair for feeding a very young child; has four long legs and a footrest and a detachable tray

examples.en: The baby happily banged her wooden spoon against the tray of the highchair.
examples.zh: 小宝宝高兴地拿着木勺敲打着高脚餐椅的托盘。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 highchair 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a chemical agent that destroys plants or inhibits their growth

examples.en: He sprayed weedkiller along the garden path to stop the invasive dandelions growing.
examples.zh: 他在花园小径旁喷洒除草剂，以阻止蒲公英肆意蔓延。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 weedkiller 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: minute insect that feeds on plant juices; related to scale insects

examples.en: A severe infestation of whitefly threatened to ruin the entire greenhouse tomato crop.
examples.zh: 严重的粉虱虫害威胁着温室里整批番茄作物的收成。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 whitefly 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a message whose ingenuity or verbal skill or incongruity has the power to evoke laughter

examples.en: His clever witticism broke the awkward silence and amused everyone in the room.
examples.zh: 他机智的俏皮话打破了尴尬的沉默，逗乐了房间里的所有人。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 witticism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 娶妻；给...娶妻, 娶...为妻
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] (archaic) To take a woman as one's wife, or marry.

examples.en: In the ballad, the brave knight traveled across the sea to wive well.
examples.zh: 在民谣中，勇敢的骑士远渡重洋去娶一位好妻子。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 wive 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: yellow carotenoid (isomeric with lutein and occurs widely with it) that is the main pigment in yellow Indian corn

examples.en: Leafy greens like spinach are rich in zeaxanthin, which protects eye health effectively.
examples.zh: 像菠菜这样的绿叶蔬菜富含玉米黄质，能有效保护眼睛健康。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 zeaxanthin 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 迅速撤退, 迅速逃走
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] ('hightail it') (North American informal) To run away or leave a place as fast as possible.

examples.en: When the alarms blared, the terrified burglars hightailed it out the back door.
examples.zh: 警报响起时，吓坏了的窃贼们迅速从后门溜之大吉。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hightail 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a short erect tail

examples.en: The frightened rabbit vanished into the dense bushes, showing only its white scut.
examples.zh: 受惊的野兔钻进了茂密的灌木丛，只露出白色的短尾巴。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 scut 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] (formal) When two substances, ideas, or cultures interpenetrate, they spread through and merge with each other.

examples.en: Traditional melodies and modern electronic beats interpenetrate seamlessly in their new album.
examples.zh: 传统旋律与现代电子节拍在他们的新专辑中完美地相互渗透。

lemmas.def_en: the action of penetrating between or among

family_guide.root_logic: 以 interpenetrate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (cooking) To remove all the bones from meat, poultry, or fish before cooking.

examples.en: The chef showed the apprentice how to debone a chicken using a sharp knife.
examples.zh: 厨师向学徒展示了如何用锋利的刀给整只鸡去骨。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 debone 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 取下...上的别针, 拔掉闩
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To unfasten and remove pins holding clothing, hair, or paper together.

examples.en: She helped the bride unpin her heavy lace veil after the grand ceremony.
examples.zh: 盛大仪式结束后，她帮新娘取下了厚重的蕾丝面纱。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 unpin 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: （歌曲、电影或书籍）过分感伤的, 煽情的
lemmas.def_en: effusively or insincerely emotional

examples.en: I found the romance novel far too schmaltzy to take seriously at all.
examples.zh: 我觉得那部言情小说太过煽情，根本无法让人认真对待。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 schmaltzy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: abnormal sexual activity

examples.en: The clinical psychologist specialized in assessing and treating rare forms of paraphilia.
examples.zh: 这位临床心理学家专门评估和治疗罕见类型的性欲倒错。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 paraphilia 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a writer who argues in opposition to others (especially in theology)

examples.en: As a fierce polemicist, she never shied away from intense political television debates.
examples.zh: 作为一名言辞犀利的辩论家，她从不回避激烈的电视政治辩论。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 polemicist 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a white Southerner who supported Reconstruction policies after the American Civil War (usually for self-interest)

examples.en: That little scallywag stole two red apples from the orchard and ran away laughing.
examples.zh: 那个小无赖从果园偷了两个红苹果，大笑着跑掉了。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 scallywag 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 沉默寡言的, 阴沉的, 铅中毒的
lemmas.def_en: bitter or scornful; - Oscar Wilde

examples.en: His saturnine expression rarely softened, even when receiving good news from friends.
examples.zh: 即使听到朋友传来的好消息，他阴沉的表情也鲜少缓和。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 saturnine 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a landslide of rocks

examples.en: The mountain pass was completely blocked after a sudden rockslide overnight.
examples.zh: 一夜之间突发的岩崩使这条山路完全被阻断了。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rockslide 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To remake, reshape, or redesign something into a new form.

examples.en: She used spare fabric to refashion the outdated coat into something stylish.
examples.zh: 她用多余的布料将那件过时的外套改造成了时尚的新衣。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 refashion 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 反抗, 不服从, 顽抗
lemmas.def_en: the trait of being unmanageable

examples.en: The manager was frustrated by the employee's persistent recalcitrance during team meetings.
examples.zh: 在团队会议上，该员工一贯的不服从让经理感到十分沮丧。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 recalcitrance 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [地名] [巴基斯坦、尼泊尔] 伦格布尔
lemmas.def_en: hybrid between mandarin orange and lemon having very acid fruit with orange peel

examples.en: The traveler spent a quiet afternoon exploring the rural markets of Rangpur.
examples.zh: 这位旅行者在伦格布尔的乡村集市度过了一个宁静的下午。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rangpur 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: in or of the next month after the present

examples.en: Our annual general meeting is scheduled for the fifth proximo at noon.
examples.zh: 我们的年度股东大会定于下月五日中午举行。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 proximo 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: often grown as a houseplant

examples.en: A lush philodendron sat in the corner, thriving in the indirect sunlight.
examples.zh: 一盆茂盛的喜林芋摆在角落里，在散射阳光下茁壮生长。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 philodendron 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: fibrosis of the bone marrow

examples.en: Doctors diagnosed the patient with myelofibrosis after analyzing abnormal bone marrow tests.
examples.zh: 医生在分析了异常的骨髓检测结果后，诊断该患者患有骨髓纤维化。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 myelofibrosis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 周柱列, 周柱廊, 周柱中庭
lemmas.def_en: a colonnade surrounding a building or enclosing a court

examples.en: Statues of ancient philosophers were arranged neatly along the courtyard peristyle.
examples.zh: 古代哲学家的雕像整齐地排列在庭院周柱廊的沿线。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 peristyle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the branch of ecology that studies ancient ecology

examples.en: Her research in paleoecology sheds light on how prehistoric forests responded to climate change.
examples.zh: 她在古生态学方面的研究揭示了史前森林如何应对气候变化。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 paleoecology 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a workhorse used as a pack animal

examples.en: The expedition relied on a sturdy packhorse to carry heavy camping supplies.
examples.zh: 探险队依靠一匹强壮的驮马来运送沉重的露营物资。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 packhorse 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: egg-laying

examples.en: Most reptiles are oviparous animals that lay eggs with tough protective shells.
examples.zh: 大多数爬行动物是卵生动物，会产下具有坚硬保护壳的卵。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 oviparous 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 拒绝作证(黑手党徒的一种行为准则)
lemmas.def_en: a code of silence practiced by the Mafia; a refusal to give evidence to the police about criminal activities

examples.en: The gang members maintained omerta, refusing to answer any questions from detectives.
examples.zh: 帮派成员坚守沉默准则，拒绝回答侦探的任何提问。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 omerta 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a flexible rodlike structure that forms the supporting axis of the body in the lowest chordates and lowest vertebrates and in embryos of higher vertebrates

examples.en: In primitive vertebrates, the flexible notochord serves as the primary body support.
examples.zh: 在原始脊椎动物中，柔韧的脊索充当了主要的身体支撑结构。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 notochord 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: someone who spends money prodigally

examples.en: He inherited a vast fortune but quickly lost it all as a scattergood.
examples.zh: 他继承了一大笔财富，但作为一个挥霍无度的人，很快就将其败光了。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 scattergood 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: diving ducks of North America having a bluish-grey bill

examples.en: We spotted a lone scaup diving beneath the icy waters for food.
examples.zh: 我们发现了一只在冰冷水下潜泳觅食的孤单斑背潜鸭。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 scaup 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a bed where seedlings are grown before transplanting

examples.en: The gardener prepared a warm seedbed to help the delicate vegetables germinate.
examples.zh: 园丁准备了一个温暖的苗床，以帮助娇嫩的蔬菜发芽。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 seedbed 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: shooting artillery shells

examples.en: Soldiers took shelter in deep trenches to survive the relentless enemy shellfire.
examples.zh: 士兵们躲在深沟里，以躲过敌方无休止的炮火袭击。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 shellfire 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an employee who performs manual or industrial labor

examples.en: The politician promised new tax policies that would directly benefit the honest workingman.
examples.zh: 这位政客承诺实施直接造福于诚实劳动者的新税收政策。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 workingman 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 轮生的, 有涡漩的, 有螺纹的
lemmas.def_en: in the shape of a coil

examples.en: The plant is easily recognized by its distinctive whorled leaves along the stem.
examples.zh: 这种植物很容易通过其沿茎分布的独特轮生叶来识别。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 whorled 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: American nocturnal goatsucker with grey-and-white plumage

examples.en: In the quiet evening, the mournful cry of a whippoorwill echoed through the woods.
examples.zh: 在宁静的傍晚，北美夜鹰凄凉的啼鸣在树林间回荡。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 whippoorwill 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the characteristic sounds made by a horse

examples.en: A gentle whicker from the stable welcomed the farmer back every morning.
examples.zh: 每天清晨，马厩里传出的轻柔马嘶声都迎接着农夫的归来。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 whicker 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 小麦的, 小麦制成的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or derived from wheat

examples.en: The bakery filled the street with the comforting aroma of fresh wheaten bread.
examples.zh: 面包店里弥漫着新鲜全麦面包的宜人香气，飘满了整条街。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 wheaten 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a sterile liquid containing a purified protein derivative of the tuberculosis bacterium; used in the diagnosis of tuberculosis

examples.en: The nurse administered a small tuberculin skin test on my lower arm.
examples.zh: 护士在我的下臂处做了一次微量的结核菌素皮试。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tuberculin 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: quantity that can be carried by a train

examples.en: A single trainload of coal arrived at the power plant early this morning.
examples.zh: 今天清晨，整整一列火车的煤炭运抵了发电厂。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 trainload 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: material for starting a fire

examples.en: He used dry touchwood to catch the sparks and quickly start the campfire.
examples.zh: 他用干燥的火绒接住火星，迅速生起了营火。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 touchwood 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: small South American marmoset with silky fur and long nonprehensile tail

examples.en: The tiny tamarin leaped gracefully between the dense branches of the rainforest canopy.
examples.zh: 那只小巧的绢毛猴在雨林树冠茂密的枝条间轻盈跳跃。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tamarin 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a writing system whose characters represent syllables

examples.en: Students learning Cherokee must first master its unique and historic eighty-five-character syllabary.
examples.zh: 学习切罗基语的学生必须首先掌握其独特的85字音节表。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 syllabary 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (philosophy) the doctrine that knowledge and value are dependent on and limited by your subjective experience

examples.en: Critics argued that his extreme subjectivism undermined the objective truth of the historical events.
examples.zh: 批评人士认为，他极端的主观主义削弱了历史事件的客观真实性。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 subjectivism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the use of a spirometer to measure vital capacity

examples.en: The doctor used spirometry to assess how well the patient's lungs were functioning.
examples.zh: 医生通过肺活量测定法来评估该患者的肺功能状况。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 spirometry 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: formerly a contemptuous term of address to an inferior man or boy; often used in anger

examples.en: Silence, sirrah, and listen carefully before you make another foolish mistake today!
examples.zh: 闭嘴，小子，在你今天再犯蠢之前给我仔细听好！

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sirrah 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an Italian courtesy title for an unmarried woman; equivalent to `Miss', it is either used alone or before a name

examples.en: The polite waiter bowed and asked the signorina for her dinner order.
examples.zh: 礼貌的侍者躬身请那位年轻姑娘点晚餐。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 signorina 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: used as an Italian courtesy title; can be prefixed to the name or used separately

examples.en: The elderly signior tipped his hat politely to everyone passing by the plaza.
examples.zh: 那位年长的绅士礼貌地向广场上路过的每个人脱帽致意。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 signior 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the ordinal number of ninety in counting order

examples.en: The family gathered together joyfully to celebrate her ninetieth birthday last weekend.
examples.zh: 上周末全家人欢聚一堂，共同庆祝她的九十岁大寿。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ninetieth 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 铜锌锡合金, 镀金物, 仿金箔
lemmas.def_en: brass that looks like gold; used to decorate furniture

examples.en: An antique French clock decorated with gleaming ormolu sat upon the marble fireplace.
examples.zh: 一座饰有闪亮仿金铜饰的法国古董钟摆在大理石壁炉上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ormolu 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: pain in a muscle or group of muscles

examples.en: Patients infected with the virus frequently complain of intense fever and persistent myalgia.
examples.zh: 感染该病毒的患者经常抱怨剧烈发热以及持续的肌肉酸痛。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to myalgia

examples.en: Patients suffering from chronic fatigue often report severe, long-lasting myalgic pain in limbs.
examples.zh: 慢性疲劳患者常报告四肢有严重且持久的肌痛。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 myalgia 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 父子关系, 分支, 父亲身份的确定, 起源
lemmas.def_en: the kinship relation between an individual and the individual's progenitors

examples.en: Scholars carefully traced the filiation of the ancient myth across multiple European cultures.
examples.zh: 学者们仔细追溯了这一古老神话在多个欧洲文化间的流变谱系。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 filiation 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an advocate of the theory that economic fluctuations are caused by increases or decreases in the supply of money

examples.en: The prominent monetarist argued that controlling the money supply would quickly tame inflation.
examples.zh: 这位著名的货币主义者认为控制货币供应量将迅速遏制通胀。

lemmas.def_en: an economic theory holding that variations in unemployment and the rate of inflation are usually caused by changes in the supply of money

examples.en: The central bank shifted toward monetarism to curb runaway inflation during the crisis.
examples.zh: 央行在危机期间转向货币主义，以遏制失控的通货膨胀。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 monetarist 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [动]犬科动物(包括家犬、狼、狐等)
lemmas.def_en: any of various fissiped mammals with nonretractile claws and typically long muzzles

examples.en: The red fox is a remarkably adaptable wild canid found throughout North America.
examples.zh: 赤狐是一种在北美各地均有分布、适应力极强的野生犬科动物。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 canid 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: rigidly formal

examples.en: His stiff and buckram demeanor made it difficult for newcomers to relax around him.
examples.zh: 他那刻板拘谨的举止让新人在他身边很难放松下来。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 buckram 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] ('bruit about/abroad') (archaic) To spread a report or rumor widely.

examples.en: Rumors of the sudden corporate merger were bruited abroad by several financial journalists.
examples.zh: 几位财经记者迅速将企业突遭合并的传闻散播了出去。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bruit 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a spasm of the bronchi that makes exhalation difficult and noisy; associated with asthma and bronchitis

examples.en: The inhaler provided immediate and effective relief from the sudden, terrifying bronchospasm.
examples.zh: 吸入器迅速而有效地缓解了突发的、可怕的支气管痉挛。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bronchospasm 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a person dressed all in blue (as a soldier or sailor)

examples.en: A watchful bluecoat patrolled the busy city streets to deter any potential pickpockets.
examples.zh: 一名警惕的警察在繁华的城市街道上巡逻，以震慑潜在的扒手。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bluecoat 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an ornamental basin (usually in a garden) for birds to bathe in

examples.en: Two cheerful sparrows splashed happily in the stone birdbath in our backyard garden.
examples.zh: 两只欢快的小麻雀在我们后院花园的石制鸟澡盆里嬉戏拍水。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 birdbath 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a coffee cake flavored with orange rind and raisins and almonds

examples.en: She baked a rich chocolate babka with sweet swirled ribbons throughout the dough.
examples.zh: 她烤制了一个浓郁的巧克力巴布卡蛋糕，面团中布满甜美的漩涡纹理。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 babka 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: varying slightly from a perfectly spherical shape

examples.en: Modern camera lenses often use aspherical elements to reduce distortion and improve sharpness.
examples.zh: 现代相机镜头通常采用非球面镜片来减少畸变并提高锐度。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 aspherical 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (of exocrine glands) producing a secretion in which part of the secreting cell is released with the secretion

examples.en: Stress can activate apocrine glands, causing an increase in body odor.
examples.zh: 压力会激活顶泌汗腺，导致体味加重。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 apocrine 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: relating to or influenced by antinomianism

examples.en: The preacher warned the congregation against falling into extreme antinomian beliefs.
examples.zh: 传教士警告会众不要陷入极端的唯信仰论观念。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 antinomian 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the precise measurement of angles

examples.en: The X-ray revealed a slight angulation in the healing forearm bone.
examples.zh: X光片显示正在愈合的前臂骨头有轻微的角度偏斜。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 angulation 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a person who makes an affidavit

examples.en: The affiant swore under oath that all statements in the document were true.
examples.zh: 宣誓人宣誓证明文件中的所有陈述均属实。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 affiant 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a sheet or band of fibrous connective tissue separating or binding together muscles and organs etc

examples.en: The shop owner decided to install a modern wooden facia above the entrance.
examples.zh: 店主决定在入口上方安装一块现代风格的木质招牌。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 facia 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: intended to prevent terrorism

examples.en: Elite counterterrorist forces conducted a coordinated raid on the suspect's safehouse.
examples.zh: 精锐反恐部队对嫌疑人的安全屋进行了协同突袭。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 counterterrorist 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: <法>加伏特舞, 加伏特舞曲
lemmas.def_en: an old formal French dance in quadruple time

examples.en: The orchestra played a lively gavotte that delighted the entire ballroom audience.
examples.zh: 管弦乐队演奏了一首轻快的加伏特舞曲，令全场舞会观众十分欣喜。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gavotte 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the part of the small intestine between the duodenum and the ileum

examples.en: Nutrients are primarily absorbed in the jejunum during the digestive process.
examples.zh: 在消化过程中，营养物质主要在空肠中被吸收。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 jejunum 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: at or near or toward the center of a ship

examples.en: The cargo was carefully loaded midships to maintain the vessel's balance.
examples.zh: 货物被小心地装在船中部，以保持船体平衡。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 midships 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the act of changing from imperial units of measurement to metric units: meters, grams, seconds

examples.en: The country completed its gradual metrication program after several decades of transition.
examples.zh: 经过数十年的过渡，该国完成了循序渐进的公制化进程。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 metrication 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: being in or directed toward the midline or mesial plane of the body

examples.en: The dentist noticed early signs of decay on the mesial surface of the tooth.
examples.zh: 牙医注意到该牙齿近中面有早期的蛀牙迹象。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mesial 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [网络] 多重性标志准则；材料的多重性标志导则
lemmas.def_en: being eight more than fifty

examples.en: The historical treaty is detailed in chapter LVIII of the ancient manuscript.
examples.zh: 这份历史条约在古代手稿的第58章中有详细记载。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lviii 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 祭司长的, 大主教的, 教主的, 高僧的; 位高有权势者的, 有权者的
lemmas.def_en: classified according to various criteria into successive levels or layers

examples.en: The corporation maintains a strict hierarchal structure with clearly defined responsibilities.
examples.zh: 该企业保持着严格的等级结构，职责划分十分明确。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hierarchal 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or resembling a lobule

examples.en: The biopsy confirmed that the tumor originated in the breast's lobular tissue.
examples.zh: 活检证实该肿瘤起源于乳腺的小叶组织。

lemmas.def_en: a small lobe or subdivision of a lobe

examples.en: The doctor examined the small inflamed lobule on the lower part of her ear.
examples.zh: 医生检查了她耳朵下方发炎的小耳垂。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lobular 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: small leaping insect that sucks the juices of plants

examples.en: A tiny green leafhopper rested quietly on the underside of the grape leaf.
examples.zh: 一只微小的绿色叶蝉静静地停在葡萄叶的背面。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 leafhopper 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: air-breathing fish having an elongated body and fleshy paired fins; certain species construct mucus-lined mud coverings in which to survive drought

examples.en: The African lungfish can survive dry seasons by burrowing into the mud.
examples.zh: 非洲肺鱼可以通过钻入泥中度过干旱季节。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lungfish 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a musician who plays or composes jazz music

examples.en: The seasoned jazzman played a mournful solo on his battered brass trumpet.
examples.zh: 那位经验丰富的爵士音乐家用破旧的小号吹奏了一段哀伤的独奏。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 jazzman 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 水圈, 水界, 水气
lemmas.def_en: the watery layer of the earth's surface; includes water vapor

examples.en: Human industrial activities have significant long-term effects on the global hydrosphere.
examples.zh: 人类的工业活动对全球水圈有着重大的长期影响。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hydrosphere 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: （高山等上的）常积不消的冰, 冰盖
lemmas.def_en: a mass of ice and snow that permanently covers a large area of land (e.g., the polar regions or a mountain peak)

examples.en: Rising temperatures are causing the polar icecap to melt at an alarming rate.
examples.zh: 气温上升正导致极地冰盖以惊人的速度融化。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 icecap 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: handwritten book or document

examples.en: The museum proudly displays an authentic holograph of the president's famous speech.
examples.zh: 博物馆骄傲地展出了总统著名演讲的亲笔手稿真迹。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 holograph 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: affectedly genteel

examples.en: The politician avoided highfalutin language and spoke directly to everyday voters.
examples.zh: 这位政客避免使用夸夸其谈的辞藻，而是直接与普通选民对话。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 highfalutin 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to a decrease in the volume of circulating blood

examples.en: Severe dehydration left the patient weak and vulnerable to hypovolemic shock.
examples.zh: 严重脱水使患者十分虚弱，极易发生低血容量性休克。

lemmas.def_zh: 血容量减少, 血容量过低
lemmas.def_en: a blood disorder consisting of a decrease in the volume of circulating blood

examples.en: Severe dehydration from the marathon caused hypovolemia, requiring immediate intravenous fluid replacement.
examples.zh: 马拉松引起的严重脱水导致血容量不足，需要立即静脉补液。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hypovolemic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 憎恨, 憎恶, 诅咒；诅咒
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (formal) To hate, detest, or curse someone or something intensely.

examples.en: Citizens gathered in the central square to publicly execrate the brutal dictator.
examples.zh: 市民们聚集在中心广场，公开谴责并诅咒这名残暴的独裁者。

lemmas.def_zh: 憎恶, 诅咒, 被咒骂的人(或事)
lemmas.def_en: hate coupled with disgust

family_guide.root_logic: 以 execrate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 使登陆, 使下船, 卸(货)；登陆
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] (+ from) To leave a ship or aircraft; (forestry) to strip the outer bark off a tree trunk.

examples.en: Passengers were instructed to debark carefully as soon as the ferry docked.
examples.zh: 渡轮一靠岸，乘客们就接到指示小心下船。

lemmas.def_zh: 登陆, 下船, 下车
lemmas.def_en: the act of passengers and crew getting off of a ship or aircraft

family_guide.root_logic: 以 debark 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the study of values and value judgments

examples.en: The philosophy seminar focused on axiology, exploring how human values are formed and judged.
examples.zh: 该哲学研讨会聚焦于价值论，探讨人类价值观是如何形成和判定的。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to the study of values

family_guide.root_logic: 以 axiology 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a distensible membranous sac (usually containing liquid or gas)

examples.en: The medical diagram clearly labeled the urinary bladder as the vesica urinaria.
examples.zh: 这幅医学图谱清晰地将膀胱标注为泌尿囊。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to a bladder (especially the urinary bladder)

family_guide.root_logic: 以 vesica 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an ache localized in the stomach or abdominal region

examples.en: Eating too many unwashed green apples gave the child a terrible bellyache.
examples.zh: 吃了太多没洗的青苹果让那个孩子肚子剧烈疼痛。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bellyache 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of the color of bronze

examples.en: After spending two weeks at the beach, her skin took on a warm, bronzy glow.
examples.zh: 在海滩度过了两周后，她的皮肤泛起了一层温暖的古铜色光泽。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bronzy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: cultivated hybrid bramble of California having large dark wine-red fruit with a flavor resembling raspberries

examples.en: We picked fresh boysenberries from the garden to bake a delicious summer fruit pie.
examples.zh: 我们从花园里采摘了新鲜的博伊增莓，烤制了一个美味的夏日水果派。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 boysenberry 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 蓝舌病(羊、马等的病毒性疾病,似口蹄疫, 最早出现于南非)
lemmas.def_en: a viral disease of sheep and cattle that is transmitted by biting midges

examples.en: The local veterinarian vaccinated the entire sheep flock against the threat of bluetongue.
examples.zh: 当地兽医为整个羊群接种了疫苗，以防范蓝舌病的威胁。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bluetongue 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: in a faithful manner

examples.en: The old delivery van started dependably every morning, regardless of the freezing temperature.
examples.zh: 无论天气多么寒冷，这辆旧送货车每天早晨都能可靠地启动。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dependably 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: someone who gossips indiscreetly

examples.en: Do not tell your secret to that blabbermouth, or everyone will soon know it.
examples.zh: 别把你的秘密告诉那个长舌妇，否则很快大家都会知道。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 blabbermouth 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 长嘴鱼(颚狭长如喙的鱼,如雀鳝等),尖嘴鱼(具有剑状长嘴及上颚的鱼,如旗鱼、枪鱼等)
lemmas.def_en: primitive predaceous North American fish covered with hard scales and having long jaws with needlelike teeth

examples.en: Anglers gathered along the coast hoping to catch a massive billfish during the tournament.
examples.zh: 钓客们聚集在海岸边，希望在比赛期间捕获一条巨大的长嘴鱼。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 billfish 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (ethnic slur) offensive term for Black people

examples.en: The outdated and offensive term darky has been completely removed from modern historical texts.
examples.zh: 过时且具冒犯性的词汇“黑人”已从现代历史文献中彻底删除。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 darky 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the conductor of a band

examples.en: The bandmaster raised his baton, signaling the brass section to begin the lively march.
examples.zh: 管乐队指挥举起指挥棒，示意铜管乐声部开始演奏欢快的进行曲。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bandmaster 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or causing bacteriostasis

examples.en: This medical ointment has bacteriostatic properties that stop dangerous bacteria from multiplying rapidly.
examples.zh: 这种药膏具有抑菌特性，可以阻止危险细菌迅速繁殖。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bacteriostatic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the birds of a particular region or period

examples.en: The newly protected wetland reserve supports a remarkably diverse avifauna throughout the year.
examples.zh: 新建的受保护湿地保护区全年养育着极为多样化的鸟类群。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 avifauna 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a farewell remark

examples.en: Waving goodbye from the train platform, she called out arrivederci to her new friends.
examples.zh: 她在火车站台上挥手告别，向新朋友们喊了声“再见”。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 arrivederci 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: inability to recognize objects by use of the senses

examples.en: After the stroke, the patient suffered from visual agnosia and could not recognize familiar objects.
examples.zh: 中风后，患者患上了视觉失认症，无法辨认熟悉的物体。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 agnosia 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: small region of cytoplasm adjacent to the nucleus; contains the centrioles and serves to organize the microtubules

examples.en: During cellular division, the centrosome helps organize the microtubules into an effective spindle apparatus.
examples.zh: 在细胞分裂过程中，中心体有助于将微管组织成有效的纺锤体结构。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 centrosome 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 计程车司机, 马车夫
lemmas.def_en: someone who drives a taxi for a living

examples.en: The friendly cabdriver navigated through the crowded city streets to avoid heavy morning traffic.
examples.zh: 那位友善的出租车司机穿过拥挤的城市街道，以避开早高峰的拥堵。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cabdriver 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (geology) a long winding ridge of post glacial gravel and other sediment; deposited by meltwater from glaciers or ice sheets

examples.en: Geologists hiked along the narrow, winding esker formed by an ancient melting glacier.
examples.zh: 地质学家沿着古老融化冰川形成的狭窄蜿蜒的蛇形丘徒步。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 esker 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 研究原则, 推理法, <<工具论>>
lemmas.def_en: a system of principles for philosophic or scientific investigations; an instrument for acquiring knowledge

examples.en: Scholars debated whether his theoretical framework could serve as a universal organon for scientific inquiry.
examples.zh: 学者们辩论他的理论框架是否可以作为科学探究的通用工具与准则。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 organon 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: movable property (as distinguished from real estate)

examples.en: His extensive estate was divided between valuable real estate and considerable personalty, including stocks.
examples.zh: 他庞大的遗产被划分为有价值的房地产以及包括股票在内的大量动产。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 personalty 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 欧洲种的兔子, 家兔
lemmas.def_en: cheese melted with ale or beer served over toast

examples.en: For a quick lunch, we ordered a traditional Welsh rarebit with melted savory cheese.
examples.zh: 为了快捷地吃顿午餐，我们点了一份配有融化咸芝士的传统威尔士干酪烤面包。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rarebit 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a B vitamin that is essential for metabolism of amino acids and starch

examples.en: The biochemist explained that pyridoxal is an active form of vitamin B6 essential for metabolism.
examples.zh: 生物化学家解释说，吡哆醛是代谢所必需的维生素B6活性形式。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pyridoxal 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the tiny fossil cone-shaped tooth of a primitive vertebrate of order Conodonta

examples.en: Fossils of the tiny conodont were used by researchers to accurately date the marine rock layers.
examples.zh: 研究人员利用微小牙形刺的化石对海洋岩层进行了精确测年。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 conodont 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or near the pudendum

examples.en: The surgeon administered a pudendal nerve block to numb the pelvic region during the procedure.
examples.zh: 外科医生在手术过程中实施了阴部神经阻滞以麻醉骨盆区域。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pudendal 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the musical director of a choir

examples.en: The precentor sang the opening verse clearly before the rest of the choir joined in.
examples.zh: 在合唱团其他人加入之前，领唱人清晰地唱出了开篇诗节。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 precentor 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the condition of being polyploid

examples.en: Polyploidy is a significant mechanism driving evolution and diversity in flowering plants.
examples.zh: 多倍性是推动有花植物进化和多样性的重要机制。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 polyploidy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: meal made of finely ground corn mixed with sugar and spices

examples.en: The long-distance runners relied on pinole mixed with water for sustained energy.
examples.zh: 长跑运动员依靠加水调和的炒玉米粉来维持能量。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pinole 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: completely satisfactory; ; - John O'Hara

examples.en: After a quick engine check, the mechanic assured us everything was copacetic.
examples.zh: 快速检查完引擎后，机械师向我们保证一切都好极了。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 copacetic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: large African antelope with long straight nearly upright horns

examples.en: During the cultural festival, locals gathered around boards to play the traditional pasang.
examples.zh: 在文化节期间，当地人围坐在棋盘旁下传统的拓棋。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pasang 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a small rounded boat made of hides stretched over a wicker frame; still used in some parts of Great Britain

examples.en: The fisherman guided his circular coracle smoothly across the misty, quiet river.
examples.zh: 渔民划着他的圆形柳条小船，平稳地穿过雾气弥漫的宁静河流。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 coracle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: small tree native to the eastern United States having oblong leaves and fleshy fruit

examples.en: She picked a ripe papaw from the tree to make a refreshing dessert.
examples.zh: 她从树上摘下一只成熟的番木瓜做了一道清爽的甜点。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 papaw 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 枯燥乏味的文章、思想,精神食量
lemmas.def_en: a soft form of cereal for infants

examples.en: Critics dismissed the candidate's speech as nothing more than bland political pablum.
examples.zh: 批评人士认为这位候选人的演讲不过是枯燥乏味的政治陈词滥调。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pablum 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To give too much importance or attention to one detail or aspect.

examples.en: Health experts repeatedly overemphasize the dangers while ignoring the practical benefits.
examples.zh: 健康专家一再过分强调危险，却忽略了实际的益处。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 overemphasize 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: reverent petition to a deity

examples.en: In the quiet chapel, the elderly monk offered a silent orison for peace.
examples.zh: 在安静的小教堂里，老修道士为和平献上了无声的祈祷。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 orison 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: luminescence resulting from a chemical reaction as the oxidation of luciferin in fireflies

examples.en: The scientist demonstrated chemiluminescence by mixing two clear liquids that glowed bright blue.
examples.zh: 科学家混合了两种发出亮蓝色光芒的透明液体，演示了化学发光现象。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 chemiluminescence 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: freshwater duck of Eurasia and northern Africa related to mallards and teals

examples.en: A flock of wigeon rested quietly along the reedy banks of the marsh.
examples.zh: 一群赤颈凫在沼泽长满芦苇的岸边安静地歇息。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 wigeon 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 油质的, 油腻的, 油嘴的
lemmas.def_en: unpleasantly and excessively suave or ingratiating in manner or speech

examples.en: His oleaginous flattery failed to deceive anyone in the meeting room.
examples.zh: 他在会议室里油嘴滑舌的奉承没能骗过任何人。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 oleaginous 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 惠赐, 允许, 给予
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (+ to) (formal or archaic) To grant, give, or reveal something to someone as a special favor.

examples.en: The mysterious author did not vouchsafe an explanation for his sudden retirement.
examples.zh: 这位神秘的作者并未对自己的突然隐退给予任何解释。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 vouchsafe 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 背诵者, 吟诵者, 朗诵者
lemmas.def_en: someone who recites from memory

examples.en: The talented reciter captivated the audience with his passionate delivery of classic poetry.
examples.zh: 那位才华横溢的朗诵者以他对古典诗歌的深情演绎吸引了观众。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 reciter 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 深奥的, 难解的, 隐藏的
lemmas.def_en: difficult to penetrate; incomprehensible to one of ordinary understanding or knowledge

examples.en: His latest book delves into the recondite principles of theoretical quantum mechanics.
examples.zh: 他的新书深入探讨了理论量子力学中深奥难解的原理。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 recondite 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or characterized by configuration

examples.en: The chemist analyzed the configurational changes of the complex molecule during the reaction.
examples.zh: 化学家分析了该复杂分子在反应过程中的构形变化。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 configurational 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 该受责备的, 可非难的, 该罚的
lemmas.def_en: bringing or deserving severe rebuke or censure

examples.en: Such reckless disregard for public safety is utterly condemnable and deserves punishment.
examples.zh: 这种对公共安全的肆意漠视完全该受谴责，理应受到惩罚。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 condemnable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: without warning or announcement; ; - M.A.D.Howe

examples.en: The sudden, unpredicted snowstorm caused massive traffic delays across the entire region.
examples.zh: 这场突如其来且未被预报的暴风雪导致整个地区交通严重延误。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 unpredicted 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the position of chieftain

examples.en: A fierce dispute arose among the brothers over the rightful succession to the chieftaincy.
examples.zh: 兄弟之间就酋长职位的合法继承权发生了一场激烈的纷争。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 chieftaincy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a knitted fabric or one resembling knitting

examples.en: This lightweight athletic jacket is lined with soft tricot for extra comfort.
examples.zh: 这款轻便的运动夹克采用柔软的经编针织布做内衬，更加舒适。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tricot 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 麻痹的, 迟缓的, 迟钝的, 蛰伏的
lemmas.def_en: slow and apathetic

examples.en: The cold winter morning left the reptiles torpid and reluctant to move.
examples.zh: 寒冷的冬日清晨让爬行动物变得迟钝麻木，不愿动弹。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 torpid 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a salt of thiocyanic acid; formed when alkaline cyanides are fused with sulfur

examples.en: The laboratory technician carefully measured the concentration of thiocyanate in the water sample.
examples.zh: 实验技术人员仔细测量了水样中硫氰酸盐的浓度。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 thiocyanate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 高脚五斗橱, 双层柜
lemmas.def_en: a tall chest of drawers divided into two sections and supported on four legs

examples.en: She kept her finest linens folded neatly inside the antique oak tallboy.
examples.zh: 她把最好的亚麻织品整齐地叠放在古董橡木高脚五斗橱里。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tallboy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an acrobatic feat in which the feet roll over the head (either forward or backward) and return

examples.en: The agile gymnast performed a flawless summerset before landing perfectly on the mat.
examples.zh: 敏捷的体操运动员在完美落在垫子上之前做了一个无可挑剔的翻筋斗。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 summerset 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a short straight stick of wood

examples.en: The farmer drove a heavy wooden stob into the ground to anchor the fence.
examples.zh: 农夫把一根沉重的木桩砸进地里以固定栅栏。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 stob 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: flightless New Zealand rail of thievish disposition having short wings each with a spur used in fighting

examples.en: A curious weka emerged from the coastal bushes to inspect our picnic basket.
examples.zh: 一只好奇的新西兰短翼秧鸡从海滩灌木丛中钻出来打量我们的野餐篮。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 weka 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: someone who spoils the pleasure of others

examples.en: Don't be a spoilsport and leave the party just as everyone is having fun.
examples.zh: 别当扫兴的人，大家正玩得开心呢，你怎么就要走。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 spoilsport 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a photographic record of a spectrum

examples.en: The linguist analyzed the speech recording using an acoustic spectrogram on her screen.
examples.zh: 语言学家在屏幕上利用声谱图分析了这段语音录音。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 spectrogram 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of a firearm; not having rifling or internal spiral grooves inside the barrel

examples.en: He practiced clay shooting with an antique smoothbore shotgun inherited from his grandfather.
examples.zh: 他用祖父传下来的古董滑膛猎枪练习打飞碟。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 smoothbore 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] (informal) To run away quickly in a hurry or panic.

examples.en: When the neighbors heard the alarm, the teenagers quickly skedaddled down the alley.
examples.zh: 邻居们听到警报声时，那些青少年迅速溜进了小巷。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 skedaddle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 领主特权, 硬币铸造税
lemmas.def_en: charged by a government for coining bullion

examples.en: The government gains significant seigniorage when printing low-cost banknotes for widespread circulation.
examples.zh: 政府在印制低成本纸币进行广泛流通时获得了可观的铸币税。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 seigniorage 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a room in a monastery that is set aside for writing or copying manuscripts

examples.en: Quiet monks spent decades painstakingly copying precious manuscripts in the monastery scriptorium.
examples.zh: 安静的修道士们在修道院的缮写室里费尽心血抄写珍贵手稿数十年。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 scriptorium 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of leaves; ridged or wrinkled

examples.en: The botanist carefully classified the plant species by examining its distinct rugose leaves.
examples.zh: 植物学家通过仔细观察其独特的起皱叶片，对该植物物种进行了分类。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rugose 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an androgen (trade names Durabolin or Kabolin) that is used to treat testosterone deficiency or breast cancer or osteoporosis

examples.en: The athlete faced a lengthy suspension after testing positive for traces of nandrolone.
examples.zh: 该运动员在被检出微量诺龙呈阳性后面临长期禁赛。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 nandrolone 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a spot that is open late at night and that provides entertainment (as singers or dancers) as well as dancing and food and drink

examples.en: This trendy downtown nightspot features live jazz performances every single Friday evening.
examples.zh: 这家时尚的市中心夜总会每周五晚都会举行现场爵士乐演出。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 nightspot 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 腐朽, 崩塌；使腐朽, 使崩塌
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] (US spelling of moulder) To decay, rot, and crumble away slowly from disuse.

examples.en: Old wooden crates were left to molder in the damp, forgotten basement corner.
examples.zh: 旧木箱被遗弃在潮湿又被人遗忘的地下室角落里慢慢腐朽。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 molder 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the longest and thickest bone of the human skeleton; extends from the pelvis to the knee

examples.en: The physical therapist treated a minor tear in the patient's rectus femoris muscle.
examples.zh: 理疗师治疗了患者股直肌的一处轻微撕裂。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 femoris 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 护喉甲胃, (妇女用)肩布, 项链
lemmas.def_en: armor plate that protects the neck

examples.en: The knight strapped on a polished steel gorget to shield his vulnerable throat.
examples.zh: 骑士系上抛光的钢制护喉甲，以保护脆弱的颈部。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gorget 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: meter for detecting or comparing or measuring small electric currents

examples.en: The physics students used a sensitive galvanometer to detect faint electrical currents.
examples.zh: 物理系学生使用灵敏的电流计来检测微弱的电流。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 galvanometer 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [地名] [巴拿马] 加伊纳; [地名] [意大利] 加利纳
lemmas.def_en: small Asiatic wild bird; believed to be ancestral to domestic fowl

examples.en: We spent our summer vacation exploring the charming and peaceful village of Gallina.
examples.zh: 我们在迷人而宁静的加伊纳村度过了暑假。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gallina 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: covering with fine light hairs

examples.en: She examined the delicate, fuzzed peach skin under the bright morning kitchen sunlight.
examples.zh: 在清晨厨房明亮的阳光下，她仔细端详着桃子细腻且毛茸茸的表皮。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fuzzed 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a race run on foot

examples.en: Dozens of eager local runners lined up at dawn for the annual footrace.
examples.zh: 数十名热切的当地跑步爱好者在黎明时分排队参加一年一度的赛跑。
